job_description:
Data Analyst

We are hiring a data analyst to own reporting and experimentation. You will build dashboards, run analysis, and deliver insights to product teams.

Requirements:
- Strong SQL and data analysis skills
- Experience building dashboards and business intelligence reporting
- Familiarity with experimentation and A/B testing
- Python for automation is a plus
notes: Strong data-analytics match, mid-level; SQL/dashboards/experimentation resume aligned to an analyst JD. Exercises the data-analytics discipline.
